notes: Implemented exact parallel-axis cylinder classification in parallel_cylinders.rs: same-axis (Coincident/Empty), external tangency/Parallel (zout), internal tangency/containment/transverse (zin), all by decisive inari interval predicates (three_way) on the f64 carrier parameters. Every Ok returns the full field-by-field Certificate with Method::Exact, AnalyticCarrier=True, zero budget, UNBOUNDED margin, Unbounded modulus, per BG-EVD-002 (no certificate helper). Transverse lines follow decision 6 verbatim. Internal-tangency contact line: the packet says ell=r0 for external and 'the appropriate sign for internal'; deriving |ell|=r0 and |ell-d|=r1 gives ell=r0 when r0>=r1 and ell=-r0 when r0<r1, which the internal-tangency test verifies numerically (r0=2,r1=1,d=1 -> line at (2,0,z), on both carriers to machine precision) so no correction was needed. The margin sweep (2-1/16, 2-1/256, 2-2^-20, 2, 2+2^-20, 2+1/256, 2+1/16) is refusal-free: TwoCurves,TwoCurves,TwoCurves,TangentLine,Parallel,Parallel,Parallel, all dyadic-written-as-arithmetic. Straddle report: no genuine straddle refusal is constructible from f64 carrier parameters - d2=dx^2+dy^2 of degenerate singletons is always a degenerate interval, so every predicate stays decisive; the bit-neighbour witnesses d=2+/-1ulp both classify without refusing (transverse below, parallel above), confirming the design. The undecidable refuse path is nonetheless real and is unit-tested: a hand-built [-w,w] interval is neither decisively_zero nor excludes_zero, and overlapping non-degenerate intervals give three_way==None. The refusal arms assert straddles_zero (the negated conjunction of decisively_zero/excludes_zero) to document that the refusal is exactly the undecidability. Refusal shape is uniformly Refusal::NumericallyUnresolved{spent:Budget(0,0,0), witness:RootNotIsolated}. All six required tests added; verification commands and scripts/kernel-gates.sh all pass (GATE-4 unscaled_legacy 109/109 unchanged); existing 95 lib + 3 integration tests unchanged.
